name: fitweb-gate-real-3-crossroad-1
prompt: Edit this image and keep everything already in it exactly the same: the camera, framing, the gate canopy, the left guard block with its glass cabin, the FIT logo and copper plaque, the right pillar with the Forteasia logo, the canopy lettering FORTEASIA INDUSTRIAL TOWNSHIP, the single red-and-white boom barrier at the guard cabin (exactly one barrier, add no other barrier or pole), the container truck, tipper truck, pickup, forklift, flags, workers, grass, walls, the navy warehouse, colours and soft light. Make two additions, built as a miniature scale model in exactly the same style as the rest: 1) A CROSS ROAD just inside the gate: a few metres past the canopy, add a wide two-lane asphalt road with white dashed markings and kerbs that runs straight across the township, perpendicular to the entry road, from the far left edge of the model to the far right edge, meeting the entry road in a clean four-way junction. Open the central green median at the junction so trucks can turn left or right, add curved turning lanes with arrow markings at the corners. Both ends of the cross road fade softly into the beige background like the rest of the model, never a hard cut. 2) A WORKING FACTORY on the RIGHT side of the image, on the empty beige area to the right of the entry road and behind the right Forteasia pillar, with its own paved yard connected to the new cross road: a large industrial factory building with a light-grey and navy ribbed metal facade, a saw-tooth roof with skylights and rooftop solar panels, a short chimney or exhaust stack with a thin wisp of white steam, two loading-bay doors with roller shutters, one open with warm light inside, a small office block with windows at its corner, a truck backed up to one bay, a forklift with pallets, stacked crates, tiny workers in hi-vis vests and a few trees. It sits firmly on the ground at the same scale as the warehouse, not floating. Leave the LEFT side of the image as it is now: do not add any factory or building on the left. No text or logos on the factory or road, no watermark.
